name: Alex Morgan
title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
bio: Professor Morgan's research interests include machine learning, graph mining, anomaly detection, and biomedical applications of AI. Recent projects focus on improving the reliability of large language models.

name: Sam Okafor
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
bio: Professor Okafor's research lies at the intersection of computer vision and multimodal learning, with a focus on video understanding and 3D scene reconstruction.
university: Example Institute of Technology, London, UK

name: Priya Chandran
title: Professor of Computer Science
bio: Professor Chandran's teaching and research interests span natural language processing, computational linguistics, and low-resource language technologies.

name: Jordan Lee
title: Professor of Electrical Engineering
bio: Professor Lee's research interests include distributed systems, computer networks, and cybersecurity, with a focus on secure protocols for IoT devices.
university: Example University of Technology, Sydney, Australia
